headline: HuyenBao v11.14 — Tử Vi (紫微斗数) natal chart integrated from Huyen-Hoc-AI
summary: Second Huyen-Hoc-AI feature brought into the main app: a simplified Tử Vi natal chart (lá số) in the Spirit tab. The full deterministic engine — AmLich solar→lunar conversion (Vietnamese UTC+7), nạp âm, cục mệnh, Tử Vi star placement, all 14 chính tinh, 13 phụ tinh (Tả Phù/Hữu Bật/Văn Xương/Văn Khúc/Thiên Khôi/Thiên Việt/Lộc Tồn/Kình Dương/Đà La/Hỏa Tinh/Linh Tinh/Đào Hoa/Hồng Loan), and per-star trạng thái (Miếu/Vượng/Đắc/Bình/Hãm) across 12 palaces — is ported verbatim from the Huyen-Hoc-AI FastAPI backend to TypeScript (src/lib/tuvi.ts) and runs client-side. A new /api/tuvi endpoint interprets the chart through the app's existing local LLM (Ollama, same client as /api/story and /api/divine), falling back to ZAI cloud then to a deterministic local reading. The chart uses the character's birth year + month (already collected) plus a day and hour the player enters in the panel — no save-state change. Two source typos were fixed in the port (Hồng Loan lookup, giờ sinh label). The chart is a simplified reference per the source disclaimer; it may differ from a given Tử Vi school.
features: New Tử Vi panel in the Spirit tab: birth-day + birth-hour inputs → full lá số (solar/lunar dates, year Can-Chi, Cục, Mệnh/Thân/Tử-Vi positions, 12-palace grid with chính tinh + trạng thái colour-coded + phụ tinh, LLM interpretation + reflection)

src/lib/tuvi.ts: full deterministic engine ported from Huyen-Hoc-AI — AmLich (jd, new moon, sun longitude, lunar month 11, leap month offset, solar→lunar), nạp âm, cục mệnh (Ngũ Hổ Độn), an Tử Vi, an 14 chính tinh, an 13 phụ tinh, lap_la_so; two source typos fixed

POST /api/tuvi: LLM interpretation via the existing Ollama connection, ZAI cloud fallback, deterministic local-reading fallback — always returns a reading in the player's language; focuses on Mệnh chính tinh + Quan Lộc/Tài Bạch/Phu Thê
12-palace 4×3 grid: Mệnh palace highlighted (accent border + ★ Mệnh), Thân palace marked, star state colour-coded (Miếu/Vượng/Đắc = green, Hãm = red, Bình = mute)
Uses character's byear + birthMonth (no save migration); day + hour entered in-panel per reading
Disclaimer notes (ghi_chu + disc.aiNote) shown under every reading
Version bumped to v11.14 on homepage header + version.json
